item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 14/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China. With the upper-air disturbance departing, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong towards the weekend. A strong northeast monsoon will reach southern China during the weekend. The weather will be mainly fine over the region early next week.
